title: Alan Prade the vocalist and New Iberia drummers
summary: Reason describes Barnes's big singer who used a megaphone and drummers around New Iberia, including one from Celestin's band.

story.theme_name: Drummers and drumming: who played what, and how
story.community_name: Great drummers: who they admired and why

blocks.x: I see. Yeah. And then, then who was Alan Prade? Alan Prade was the vocalist in Paul D. Barnes' band.

I see. He was a great big guy. He was fat, huh? Oh, yeah. And he didn't have electric loud speakers in those days. He used a little megaphone. Like Joe Lawrence used to do with Papa Celestine. Mm-hmm. He was about two blocks away. And he was from St. Martinville. Mm-hmm. Right out of New Iberia. Eight miles out of New Iberia.
And during that time, Bum Johnson was living in New Iberia. Mm-hmm. And another drummer by the name of Chayee, who used to be a drummer with Papa Celestine.
A little bit of a fella. Yeah. Yeah. And he was with Punch for a while. That's right.
